changes: Added @test story-storage-migration to story_migrate_storage and @test story-sync-main to story_sync_main in packages/main/src/handlers/story-query.ts. This clears the last two cli-validate warning lines without changing runtime code.
usage: Run node packages/main/dist/tasks/cli-validate.js. The task annotation report should show Errors: 0 and Warnings: 0, followed by PASSED: All task annotations are valid.
expectedOutcome: The user sees cli-validate output with Errors: 0 and Warnings: 0, and no WARN lines mentioning story_migrate_storage or story_sync_main missing @test annotation.
actualTranscript: cli-validate scanned 326 files, found 49 tasks, reported Errors: 0 and Warnings: 0, and printed PASSED: All task annotations are valid.
outcomeDiff: No mismatch; the two warning lines are gone and no runtime code changed.
limitations: none — fully covered for the two remaining cli-validate warnings
pitfalls: The story worktree needed packages/main build and core-only CLI again because bin/lattice.js depends on missing packages/utils dist in fresh worktrees. .koala story metadata remains ignored, so story metadata had to be force-added during the lifecycle and will be removed from the main index after DONE.
